contracts.loop: Open path, install Audio command table810470, read lines until0, get first token, dispatch iff first byte nonzero, then close. Native ignores token reader return.
contracts.banks: After close reread bank count/base and write terminator first16bytes0/0/0/-1; preserve12remaining bytes. Load current bank base with caller cursor/opaque.
contracts.tail: Clear200mask bytes after bank loading; reread2962034 to optionally apply100words; finish unconditionally, including missing-file case.

native.method: Original6520b0 including actual memset executes. File/scanner/dispatch/close and bank/device services expose raw argument order and complete entry-image hashes; mutable count, bank base, mask and post-load flag changes are exercised.
limits: This recovers configuration orchestration, not the native file scanner, dispatcher, bank loader or audio device. Valid parser/token/bank backing, adequate capacity and terminating service sequence are required.
The token-reader return value is ignored; dispatch tests current token first byte. Missing file still proceeds through bank terminator, load, zero mask, optional mask application and finish.
Bank terminator touches only its first16bytes. Post-load flag is reread after clearing200mask bytes. Services are synchronous and may mutate shared state. Managed replay pending.
